protocol.sizing: Integer target quantities fixed from signal-day closing prices. Equal target capital per selected issuer. Sell reductions before buying increases; deterministic ticker order. Unaffordable shares remain unfilled, with no cash borrowing.
protocol.retained_positions: Only quantity differences trade; retained quantities do not pay a fictitious round trip.
protocol.cash: Trade proceeds and purchase obligations may offset only on their dated settlement schedule. Ordinary dividends/JCP become receivables on the ex session for the prior entitled position; actual payment is credited at the end of its date, available for the following session. Unpaid receivables do not fund purchases.
protocol.tax: Brazilian resident individual research scenario, no outside trades or income assumed. Only explicitly supplied and source-reviewed tax treatments and cost-basis actions are accepted. No guessed treatment for compulsory conversions, foreign distributions or auctioned fractions.
protocol.corporate_actions: Require exact security identity, quantity, credit dates, cash dates and disposal/retained basis allocation. Fractional entitlements are unavailable until a documented cash-in-lieu payment or a verified tradable delivery. Do not round a legal entitlement into cash at a convenient quote.
protocol.required_gate: Full strategy and comparison cash-coverage inventory including successor intervals; unique entitlements/installments; quote and identity coverage; usable delivery and fractional terms; dated tax specification. Fail before publishing returns if an input is missing.
protocol.stopping_rule: Do not change factors, periods or hurdles to rescue historical results. Pause if source repair cannot cheaply establish an executable and economically meaningful comparison. No total-return or net-profit claim from incomplete coverage.
